findings.summary: Legacy maintenance gate resolved the wrong tree
findings.detail: The inherited checker walked upward looking for a directory named scikitplot even though it lived under maintenances/cython, then scanned the maintenance plane as runtime and reported the real tests/templates as disappeared. The live tools now discover the wide repository root explicitly.

findings.summary: Checked-in bytecode cache ships in the runtime source tree
findings.detail: scikitplot/cython/__pycache__/_lock.cpython-311.pyc is present in the uploaded archive. Source releases should not carry interpreter-specific bytecode; the contract gate fails closed while any __pycache__ or .pyc remains.

findings.summary: Full-suite setuptools/distutils state pollution masks three real-compile checks
findings.detail: In a clean package-root harness the suite reports 1240 passed / 8 skipped. Three skips explicitly cite CYTHON-CON-002 global-state pollution; each passes when executed in isolation. test_second_call_uses_cache_not_reimport evicts setuptools/distutils modules without restoring sys.modules, so later real-build evidence is order-dependent. Release evidence must not count those skips as successful compilation coverage.

findings.summary: Uploaded archive lacks top-level scikitplot package root
findings.detail: There is no scikitplot/__init__.py in this partial archive. Direct pytest collection therefore treats scikitplot/cython/tests as package cython.tests and shadows external Cython's lowercase cython helper. A throwaway package-root harness was used only to evaluate the submodule; installed-package/wheel behavior still requires a complete checkout.
